description.value:
Prerequisite(s): Str 15, Improved Unarmed Strike, Dragon Style, Stunning Fist, Acrobatics 8 ranks

Benefit: You gain one additional Stunning Fist attempt per day. While using Dragon Style, as a standard action you can expend two Stunning Fist attempts to unleash a concussive roar in a 15-foot cone. Creatures caught in the cone take your unarmed strike damage and become shaken for 1d4 rounds. A successful Will save reduces the damage by half and prevents a target from being shaken.

system.requirements: Str 15, Improved Unarmed Strike, Dragon Style, Stunning Fist, Acrobatics 8 ranks
